stem: Developing skeletal tissue initially contains a hyaline cartilage model. Follow-up sections show removal of that template and deposition of bone in its place. Which of the following interpretations best describes the process observed?

options.label: A
options.text: Intramembranous ossification through a required cartilage template
options.explanation: Intramembranous ossification forms bone directly from mesenchymal tissue. A required hyaline cartilage template instead identifies the endochondral pathway described by these sequential observations.
options.misconception: Assigns a required cartilage template to intramembranous ossification.

options.label: B
options.text: Endochondral ossification with direct conversion of cartilage matrix
options.explanation: The cartilage model provides a template that is removed and replaced by bone. It is not simply converted into bone matrix, as the separate removal and deposition observations demonstrate.
options.misconception: Mistakes cartilage removal and replacement for direct matrix conversion.

options.label: C
options.text: Endochondral ossification with replacement of a cartilage template
options.explanation: Endochondral ossification replaces a pre-existing hyaline cartilage model with bone. Removal of the template followed by bone deposition is the defining sequence in this preparation.
options.misconception: No misconception: endochondral ossification replaces a hyaline cartilage model.

options.label: D
options.text: Intramembranous ossification through osteoclast matrix deposition
options.explanation: Osteoclasts resorb bone rather than deposit its matrix. In addition, the observed cartilage template distinguishes this developmental process from direct intramembranous formation of bone.
options.misconception: Assigns matrix deposition to osteoclasts and ignores the cartilage template.

options.label: E
options.text: Endochondral ossification through resorption without bone deposition
options.explanation: Removal of cartilage alone would not account for the bone seen on follow-up sections. Endochondral ossification includes replacement with newly deposited bone, not resorption without formation.
options.misconception: Counts template removal as ossification without the observed bone deposition.

context:
Learning objective: Distinguish replacement of a cartilage template in endochondral ossification from direct intramembranous bone formation.

Endochondral ossification replaces a pre-existing hyaline cartilage model with bone. Removal of the template followed by bone deposition is the defining sequence in this preparation.
